description: As a Magic action, choose any Cleric spell of level 5 or lower that doesn't require a Reaction to cast. As part of the same action, you cast that spell without expending a spell slot or needing Material components. You can't use this feature again until you finish a Long Rest. Surface owner need: session Spell Invocation must model a one-action free cast from the Cleric list with a level cap, non-Reaction casting-time filter, no slot spend, and Material-component suppression.
name: Divine Intervention
